name: sphmewrk
label: How much housework r's spouse does

questions.text:
We're interested in knowing how much of the work around your home is done by different people. We don't mean taking care of children - just regular work around the house, like cooking, grocery shopping and doing little repair jobs. 
B. How much does your spouse or partner do?

label: Men benefit from traditional family
